title: Fig Builds a Soft Bed
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar looking around a leafy corner for somewhere comfy to rest.
Fig the caterpillar pulling a wide soft green leaf into place.
Fig the caterpillar gathering a small tuft of soft white plant fluff.
Fig the caterpillar pressing the soft fluff down onto the green leaf.
Fig the caterpillar climbing up onto the leaf and fluff.
Fig the caterpillar lying flat on the leaf, looking unimpressed.
Fig the caterpillar tucking a small soft twig underneath one edge of the leaf.
The little leaf bed now gently raised on one side by the twig.
Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep on his new soft leaf bed.
